statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-54696 affects the json gem's C extension parser. Logstash uses JRuby, which implements JSON parsing in Java without using the vulnerable C extension code. The json gem in JRuby serves only as a compatibility shim and does not contain the vulnerable parser implementation.
